decision: The competitor (Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
event_name: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team Document 39 Date 18 June 2022 Time 11:20 2022 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 16 - 19 June 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 19 & 20) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 5 (Sebastian Vettel), the driver of Car 20 (Kevin Magnussen), and team representatives, and examined video evidence. Car 20 had to brake in the fast lane to avoid Car 5 when Car 5 was released from the garage. Consistent with decisions in previous similar cases the Stewards impose a financial penalty on the team.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Offence Car 5 Unsafe Release
